items.text: Every distinct planted blocker survives aggregation — none is dropped by axis budgeting or the finding cap.
Exact duplicate findings are merged into one.
Findings that share a root cause but have separate consequences are NOT merged.
The non-blocker noise budget cannot hide a blocker: blockers are never sacrificed to keep lower-severity findings.
Final finding order is deterministic after deduplication (severity-first, stable within severity).
